title: Codex ephemeral review integration (0A.8 item 4; AD-081..AD-088) + minimal root AGENTS.md
objective: Make the fresh-ephemeral-Codex-review loop operational end to end: bounded role-specific context packet in, read-only review, one schema-valid decision out, process exit, durable record with model identity/usage telemetry/digest; enforce the 0A.4 packet budgets; prevent Claude/Codex duplicate investigation (AD-087); record worker-fallback roles (AD-088); add a concise root AGENTS.md without duplicating CLAUDE.md (AD-041/AD-042).
business_reason: 0A.8 item 4 (fresh ephemeral Codex review) is a blocking minimum-autonomy capability; AD-081..AD-088 are explicit directive requirements.
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): fake-Codex end-to-end - a fresh process receives a bounded role-specific packet, runs read-only, returns one schema-valid decision, exits; the durable record holds decision, evidence refs, model identity, usage telemetry, and digest; a second review provably shares no state with the first (AD-027).

AS-2 (executable): packet-budget enforcement - a packet exceeding the effective ceiling (lower of the 64k-token ordinary ceiling and 20% of the reported model window) is refused with split/summarize guidance and an explicit record; no silent omission of a material requirement (0A.4).

AS-3 (executable): prohibited-content guard - packets never include full transcripts, the full directive registry, all historical reports, unrelated task packets, or the whole repository by default (fixture tests; AD-083).
AS-4 (executable): review-cadence policy invokes Codex at meaningful checkpoints only (0A.3 list) and never merely to restate a deterministic pass (policy test; AD-084).
AS-5 (executable): a concise root AGENTS.md exists covering the Section 11.1 list with a check that it does not duplicate CLAUDE.md wholesale (AD-041/AD-042).
risks: Codex CLI event shapes drift across versions - capability-probe and fixture before live use (AD-022).
